<h1 class="home-name"><strong>Hannah</strong> E.  Holland-Moritz</h1>

I use molecular and computational tools to study plant-associated and soil microbial communities. My research focuses on the environmental conditions which influence community assembly and the molecular mechanisms that underpin community functional traits. I am particularly interested in using microbial functional traits in conjunction with community assembly theory to develop more accurate predictive models of carbon release in terrestrial ecosystems.

In addition to my research interests, I’m passionate about science communication, diversity and inclusion in STEM, and lowering barriers to acquisition of computational skills for budding scientists.
